title: Keurig K155 Office Pro Single Cup Commercial K-Cup Pod Coffee Maker, Silver

Its about the best Keurig built and at that price I hope it last quite a while. I have it in a high traffic office environment so it will get tested. Makes a cup pretty quick and brews up to 35 cups per water fill depending on the size choice per cup...
